Hi all,

Since a few things seem to keep slipping through the cracks lately 🙂, I'm putting a 15 min standup on everyones calendar every morning at 9:15 starting Monday. Jada, Thandi, Vera, Nico, Darius, Raj, you're all on it, plus Imogen from planning.

Please come ready to say what you did yesterday and what your doing today. I know we all have the tracker, and I know some of us actually update it 👀, but apparently that isnt enough right now.

Cameras on would be apreciated.

Thanks so much!! 🙏
Grace
